#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long powMod(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long ans = 1LL;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) ans = (ans * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

long long comb(int n, int m, const vector<long long>& fac) {
    if (m == 0 || m == n) return 1LL;
    if (m > n || m < 0) return 0LL;
    long long denom = (fac[m] * fac[n - m]) % MOD;
    return fac[n] * powMod(denom, MOD - 2) % MOD;
}

int main() {
    int t = 1;
    while (t--) {
        int n;
        long long kk;
        cin >> n >> kk;
        vector<long long> fac(n + 1);
        fac[0] = 1LL;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
        }
        if (kk == 0) {
            cout << fac[n] << endl;
        } else if (kk >= n) {
            cout << 0 << endl;
        } else {
            int k = (int)kk;
            long long tmp = 0;
            int sign = 1;
            int l = n - k;
            for (int i = 0; i <= l; ++i) {
                long long term = powMod(l - i, n) * comb(l, l - i, fac) % MOD;
                if (sign == -1) term = (MOD - term) % MOD;
                tmp = (tmp + term) % MOD;
                sign = -sign;
            }
            long long res = 2LL * comb(n, k, fac) % MOD * tmp % MOD;
            cout << res << endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
